compatibility.http_staging_login_when_secure_false: covered by policy and environment examples

silent_login_failure_mitigation.root_cause: Secure cookies were applied in HTTP access modes, causing browsers to drop Set-Cookie and making the immediate /auth/me call unauthenticated.
silent_login_failure_mitigation.fix: Development now forces Secure=false/SameSite=lax; staging exposes an explicit Secure flag; production forces Secure=true/SameSite=none.
